<cite ref="Gittin 14b:3">Gitt. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מִיסְתֵּיה וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="M01257"><he>מִיסְתְּיֵיה</he></cite>) not enough that he did not help us but &c.
